Research Question: Can per-turn SFT examples exactly preserve recorded rollout inputs and actual generated target IDs, while preventing development data from becoming training data?
Hypothesis: Every complete valid Day 3 generation can be reconstructed with its pinned prompt hash and output IDs; strict training admission rejects all development trajectories; a fixed balanced training-only acquisition cohort fits existing initial context limits.
Independent Variable: Per-turn recorded-input/output encoding instead of whole-conversation assistant-role encoding; no policy parameter change
Metrics: prompt hash match per actual generation
target ID and raw decoding match
Evidence Gate: All actual complete generations reconstruct; development and invalid/unreviewed trajectories fail training admission; all 20 fixed training tasks fit 8192 initially without truncation. CPU pass does not establish trainer CE/update/reload or data quality.
Cost Bound: CPU only, GPU-hours=0, paid API=0, max wall time 600 seconds; read recorded dev outputs only for diagnostic encoding, no final case contents
Failure Branch: Preserve all outputs and failed checks. Do not modify raw evidence or export development targets as training data; stop GPU progression if encoding/admission fails.
data_export: Only selected training tasks may be bundled later; audited dev token arrays remain diagnostic and are not exported as a training corpus
